summary: Frontend-only regression + new Ripple Poster feature validated end-to-end. Poster generation works for both initiator (Amina, /me/j4atawQ7lw) and a freshly-joined member (created via /j/j4atawQ7lw). Poster image renders with valid data:image/png base64 (~1.87MB-1.95MB), QR + text visible, share/download buttons present. Simplified English copy is applied throughout (dashboard: 'Come back anytime to see your chain grow.', 'Your spark', 'Your rank' (label, not raw key), 'Next goal', 'Your chain', 'People you invited', 'People you reached'; join reveal shows 'YOU JOINED THE CHAIN' with no 'lit the spark' idiom; Home hero shows 'One idea. / Passed hand to hand. / See how far it goes.'). Regressions clean: personal-ripple SVG renders, spark-status + spreader-rank shown, JoinReveal continue navigates to /me/{share}, organizer dashboard /dashboard/j4atawQ7lw renders 10 charts/SVGs without errors, EN<->SO language toggle switches text.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Non-blocking a11y warning. Consider adding DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) alongside the sr-only DialogTitle in RipplePoster.jsx.

action_items: (Low priority) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Ripple Poster modal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: RipplePoster.jsx uses Math.random() during canvas draw for star jitter — poster is non-deterministic across regenerations. Acceptable for a poster but note that repeated exports differ slightly.

generate() uses a fixed 120ms setTimeout before drawing; if fonts are slow to load, first render may fall back to system fonts. Consider awaiting document.fonts.ready before opening modal, not inside async without await for the timeout.
share() fetch(preview).blob() re-parses a large base64 string — could be replaced with canvas.toBlob for efficiency.

No error toast/state if canvas.toDataURL throws (e.g., tainted canvas from cross-origin QR). Currently swallows errors silently since QR is rendered locally, but a fallback UI when preview stays null would improve UX.
